revelation.4.p1.b1.text: After this I looked and saw a door standing open in heaven.

revelation.4.p1.b2.text: “Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after these things.”

revelation.4.p2.b3.text: At once I was in the Spirit,

revelation.4.p2.b4.text: and I saw a throne standing in heaven, with someone seated on it.

revelation.4.p2.b5.text: The One seated there looked like jasper and carnelian, and a rainbow that gleamed like an emerald encircled the throne.

revelation.4.p3.b6.text: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and on these thrones sat twenty-four elders dressed in white, with golden crowns on their heads.

revelation.4.p3.b7.text: From the throne came flashes of lightning, and rumblings, and peals of thunder. Before the throne burned seven torches of fire. These are the seven Spirits of God.

revelation.4.p4.b8.text: And before the throne was something like a sea of glass, as clear as crystal.

revelation.4.p4.b9.text: In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, covered with eyes in front and back.

revelation.4.p5.b10.text: The first living creature was like a lion,

revelation.4.p5.b12.text: the third had a face like a man,

revelation.4.p5.b13.text: and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.

revelation.4.p5.b14.text: And each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stop saying:

revelation.4.p5.b15.text: “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!”

revelation.4.p6.b16.text: And whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the One seated on the throne who lives forever and ever,

revelation.4.p6.b17.text: the twenty-four elders fall down before the One seated on the throne, and they worship Him who lives forever and ever. They cast their crowns before the throne, saying:

revelation.4.p6.b18.text: “Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and came to be.”
